landing.heroTitle: Connecting disaster victims, donors, and volunteers — in real time
landing.heroSubtitle: Request, track, and deliver disaster relief across Sri Lanka, with full transparency.
landing.step1Desc: A victim describes what they need — food, water, medicine — and where, in under a minute.
landing.step2Desc: Donations are matched to the highest-priority nearby request, and a volunteer is assigned.
landing.step3Desc: The volunteer delivers, and the victim confirms receipt — closing the loop with full transparency.
landing.affectedAreasDesc: Aid request activity by district, updated live.
landing.forVictimsDesc: Submit a structured aid request in seconds, tracked from submission to delivery.
landing.forDonorsDesc: Register donations and see exactly where they go, with delivery confirmation.
landing.forVolunteersDesc: Get matched to nearby deliveries and track progress from pickup to confirmation.

footer.tagline: Connecting victims, donors, and volunteers across Sri Lanka.
footer.dataSourcesText: Live data from Sri Lanka's Disaster Management Centre and Department of Irrigation.
footer.disclaimer: Built for research and evaluation purposes. Not an official government platform.

severityMap.title: Affected Area Severity — Sri Lanka
severityMap.description: District-level request activity (not individual locations), and live river-gauge readings against flood thresholds.
severityMap.unofficialData: Live data from the Department of Irrigation's own public gauge network.
severityMap.noWarnings: No active DMC warnings right now.
severityMap.gdacsCaption: Tropical cyclone tracking and general disaster events from the Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System (EC Joint Research Centre), filtered to ones relevant to Sri Lanka.
severityMap.gdacsNoEvents: No GDACS-tracked events relevant to Sri Lanka right now.
severityMap.earthquakesTitle: Regional Seismic Activity — Tsunami Risk Indicator
severityMap.earthquakesCaption: Recent magnitude 4.0+ earthquakes from the US Geological Survey, across the Indian Ocean / Bay of Bengal / Sumatra subduction zone — the region that produced the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami. Sri Lanka itself sits on stable crust and rarely has local seismic activity; this tracks the wider zone as an early-context indicator, not a Sri Lanka earthquake feed.
severityMap.earthquakesNoEvents: No magnitude 4.0+ earthquakes in the region in the last 30 days.
severityMap.communityReportsCaption: Field reports from volunteers, verified by an admin before appearing here.
severityMap.communityReportsNoReports: No verified community reports right now.
severityMap.weatherCaption: Live conditions from OpenWeatherMap — heavy rain is an early flood signal.
severityMap.mobileSubtitle: Where aid requests are concentrated right now, by district.
severityMap.reservoirsMapCaption: Only reservoirs with known coordinates are shown on the map.
severityMap.floodRiskCaption: A dissertation-scope forecast — one input among many, not a guarantee.
